scope: Finite mechanism demonstrations: MCL grouping plus speed-aware placement (GSHetero-related); partial application, delegated near-data work and final reduction on a 3x3 mesh (currying-related); task-pack migration vs single-item transfer (PackStealLB-related). Detailed published policies were unavailable, so these original policies are explicitly abstract-level controls, not exact implementations of those papers. Logical scores/messages/byte-hops are not measured Hadoop, Charm++ or near-data hardware performance.

environment.scope: Shared cloud CPU; not student laptop; one BLAS thread.
